name: Deshaun Day
source:
Deshaun and [url=/c148291]MC[/url] met in the YFL, later going to the same junior high and high school. Been friends ever since. Brawls and all.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/move-chains-plot-70773805]Patreon[/url]]

Deshaun is the best friend of [url=/c148291]MC[/url]. From the moment they met in the local Youth league, they were thick as thieves. From school to school and team to team, they’ve been running mates.
